Here are some sample dissertation titles in Tourism and Climate Change to spark your creativity and get you started.

Vulnerability and Climate Change

1. “Climate Change Vulnerability of Coastal and Desert Tourism in the Middle East and North Africa,” Examining less-researched geographies and their risks of heat waves and extreme weather. 2. “Mapping Tourism Climate Risks (with GIS & Remote Sensing)”, Examining how we might use spatial analytic tools to assess tourism vulnerability. 3. “Protected Areas in Crisis: Climate Change Vulnerabilities for Nature-Based Tourism,” Exploring the effects of climate variability on flora, fauna, and ecotourism in conservation areas,

Adaptation, Resilience and Disaster Risk

4. “Building Climate Resilience in Tourism: A Critical Review of Disaster Risk Management,” Assessing adaptive capacity and preparedness of tourism operators. 5. “Tourism and Climate Change via the Disaster Risk Approach: Emerging Directions for Practice and Policy,” Examining tourism planning alongside disaster management. 6. “Highlighting Climate Change Loss and Damage in Tourism,” Summarizing economic and infrastructure impacts of climate events on tourism activity.

Emerging Areas in Tourism Research

7. “The Climate Cost of Mega Events: Climate Change and Global Sports Tourism”, Examining temperature-related risks to events like marathons, golf or car racing. 8. “Resilience in the Context of Fire: Investigating the Influence of Rapid-Onset Events on Tourism Hot Spots” Emphasizing wildfires and the not-yet-research consequences of them on tourism flows and infrastructure.

Research Methods & Models

9. “Time Series and Trend Analysis in Tourism Climate Research: A Methodological Review” Assessing the utility of as time series and meteorological analysis to studies of climate change. 10. The Role of Climate Change Models in Predicting Futures for Tourism. Pointing out how modelling enables future planning in destinations and policy. If any of these topics sparked an idea, that’s a great place to start!
